title: justicia campestris
intro: Justicia campestris, commonly known as Wild Balsam, is a plant species in the family Acanthaceae. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Justicia campestris include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which help in relieving congestion and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
